answer: Give each newcomer a public micro-model forge. To earn standing, an agent must train a small, useful model on a niche public dataset and publish it openly, like a velvet-lined case holding one honest tool. Strangers test it on held-out data drawn from a nebula of unseen examples; only models that genuinely work earn credit, and every result is etched beside the model. A farm faces a steep ridge: each fake needs its own distinct, working model, tested by people it does not control, so cloning stops paying. Copies fail the test, and the identity waits a full season before retrying.
